title: Reset Tipper Stats Data to Zero on the VISU_DATA Screen
summary: The Operator Station HMI VISU_DATA screen includes a Tipper Stats section with a DATA RESET button. Pressing DATA RESET clears the displayed tipper statistics data to zero.
when_to_use: Use when you need to clear the displayed Tipper Stats counters on the Operator Station HMI VISU_DATA screen (e.g., to start a fresh measurement window for Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, and Time Starved).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the VISU_DATA screen and press the DATA RESET button for the Tipper Stats section; verify the displayed values reset to zero.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI)

access_required: Operator Station HMI access to view and interact with the VISU_DATA screen
system_preconditions: Operator Station HMI is available and the VISU_DATA screen is accessible

visual_references.description: Operator Station HMI Data Screen (VISU_DATA) showing the Tipper Stats section (Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, etc.).

steps.title: Open the Operator Station HMI and navigate to the VISU_DATA screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the Tipper Stats section and its DATA RESET button.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, navigate to the VISU_DATA screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_DATA screen is displayed with the Tipper Stats section visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The Tipper Stats section is visible on VISU_DATA, including the displayed tipper statistics fields (e.g., Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, Time Starved).
steps.failure_condition: The VISU_DATA screen is not accessible or the Tipper Stats section is not visible.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_DATA
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the "VISU_DATA" screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: VISU_DATA screen includes a "Tipper Stats" section and a "DATA RESET button: Press this button to reset the data to zero." (Figure 4-20).

steps.title: Locate the DATA RESET button for the Tipper Stats section
steps.purpose: Ensure you press the correct reset control associated with the Tipper Stats counters.
steps.instruction: On the VISU_DATA screen, locate the DATA RESET button within the Tipper Stats section.
steps.expected_result: You can identify the DATA RESET button associated with the Tipper Stats section.
steps.healthy_condition: The DATA RESET button is visible in the Tipper Stats area on VISU_DATA.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find a DATA RESET button in the Tipper Stats section (or you are unsure which reset button applies to Tipper Stats).

actions.label: Find DATA RESET (Tipper Stats)
actions.exact_action: Locate the "DATA RESET" button within the "Tipper Stats" section.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot clearly identify the DATA RESET button for the Tipper Stats section, stop and escalate for support rather than pressing an incorrect reset control.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper Stats section includes a "DATA RESET button: Press this button to reset the data to zero." (Figure 4-20).

steps.title: Press DATA RESET to reset Tipper Stats to zero
steps.purpose: Clear the displayed Tipper Stats counters.
steps.instruction: Press the DATA RESET button for the Tipper Stats section.
steps.expected_result: The displayed Tipper Stats values reset to zero after the button press.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper Stats fields on VISU_DATA show zero values (including Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, and Time Starved) as displayed.
steps.failure_condition: The displayed Tipper Stats values do not reset to zero.

actions.label: Press DATA RESET
actions.exact_action: Press the DATA RESET button to reset the data to zero.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the displayed Tipper Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing the reset.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper Stats section includes "DATA RESET button: Press this button to reset the data to zero." (Figure 4-20).

steps.title: Verify Tipper Stats values reset to zero
steps.purpose: Confirm the reset took effect on the live VISU_DATA display.
steps.instruction: Verify the Tipper Stats values shown on the VISU_DATA screen have reset to zero values as displayed (e.g., Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, Time Starved).
steps.expected_result: All displayed Tipper Stats counters show zero values.
steps.healthy_condition: Totes Processed (left/right), Faults (left/right), Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, and Time Starved display zero values on VISU_DATA.
steps.failure_condition: One or more Tipper Stats fields remain non-zero after pressing DATA RESET.

actions.label: Check reset values
actions.exact_action: Verify the Tipper Stats values shown on the screen have been reset to zero values as displayed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any Tipper Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper Stats fields listed on VISU_DATA include Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, and Time Starved; DATA RESET resets the data to zero (Figure 4-20).

success_criteria: After pressing DATA RESET, the displayed Tipper Stats values on VISU_DATA show zero values.
healthy_conditions: VISU_DATA Tipper Stats counters (Totes Processed, Faults, Avg Cycle Time, Avg Totes/Hour, Time Starved) display zero values.
failure_conditions: Tipper Stats values on VISU_DATA do not reset to zero after pressing DATA RESET.
escalation_guidance: If the displayed Tipper Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing the reset.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: VISU_DATA screen showing the Tipper Stats section where the DATA RESET button is located.

missing_details: The source states DATA RESET resets the data to zero but does not specify which exact fields are zeroed beyond the displayed Tipper Stats values; this runbook verifies the displayed Tipper Stats values as shown on VISU_DATA.
